stemMd: A linear model predicts $p=0.6t+14$, where $t$ is years since 2015. What does the model predict for 2027?
explanationMd: The elapsed time is 2027−2015=12 years. Substitute t=12 to get p=0.6(12)+14=7.2+14=21.2.

distractorRationale.c: The input should be elapsed years, not a calendar-year fragment.
distractorRationale.d: This does not use the defined time origin.
distractorRationale.a: This is the increase from the initial value, omitting 14.
